warnings: No template here is submitted or approved. Every entry is DRAFT_NOT_SUBMITTED.
No secrets, tokens, or real OTP examples are stored. All example fixtures are fake.
body_spec placeholders use {{n}} positional variables; final approved copy is fixed at submission time.
provider_template_id remains null until Meta assigns one after approval.
binding_contract.binding_readiness='resolved' only where source_key is proven in repository code; 'unresolved' entries are NOT guessed.

META CATEGORY is not the same as INTERNAL CONSENT SCOPE. The consent acknowledgements are Meta category 'utility' (Meta reserves 'authentication' for OTP-shaped templates) but are persisted on the authentication lane for STORAGE COMPATIBILITY ONLY, because live DB constraints fence an ephemeral destination to that lane. ACK_TEMPLATE_CATEGORY in consentCommandResponse.ts is storage terminology and must NEVER be wired to Meta's submission category.

NOT every key enters the ordinary consent registry. Templates marked registry_expectation=ORDINARY_REGISTRY must be registered in lib/communication/outboundConsentScope.ts before they can send. The three consent acknowledgements are marked SPECIAL_EVIDENCE_BOUND_ACK and MUST NEVER be added there: their absence is what makes the STOP-acknowledgement exception non-reusable by an arbitrary caller.
A template appearing here grants no send permission. An approved provider mapping is also required, and for ordinary types a registry entry as well.

COMPONENT PROFILES are closed: STANDARD_TEXT, QUICK_REPLY, AUTH_OTP_COPY_CODE. A provider mapping cannot inject an arbitrary component shape. Authentication templates use Meta's specialised creation contract — Meta generates the body text, so the internal body_spec is descriptive only and is never submitted as the Meta body.

qf_mvp_40_decisions.campaign_ownership: QF-MVP-40 owns Meta transport, provider-account binding, template resolution, dispatch-time consent/suppression/frequency validation primitives, provider outcome normalization, provider message-id persistence, delivery callbacks and the result-ingestion contract. QF-MVP-50 owns campaign job orchestration, n8n execution, recipient claiming/batching, bounded dispatch scheduling, dead-letter, pause/resume and aggregation. No temporary Core campaign queue consumer is built in QF-MVP-40.
qf_mvp_40_decisions.minimum_template_strategy: Smallest catalogue that satisfies the locked 40.4 families. Two deliberate consolidations (vendor lead offer carries accept/reject; onboarding reminder carries document reminder via one required variable). Marketing and transactional purposes are never merged.
qf_mvp_40_decisions.no_active_mapping_before_approval: No provider mapping row is created and no template is marked approved. approval_status stays 'draft' and submission_state stays DRAFT_NOT_SUBMITTED until Meta approves and an operator seeds the mapping in a later subphase.
qf_mvp_40_decisions.no_real_submission: No Meta Graph API call, no template submission and no message send occurred in QF-MVP-40.4.
qf_mvp_40_decisions.template_registry_boundary: Ordinary outbound types are authorised by lib/communication/outboundConsentScope.ts. The three consent acknowledgements are authorised ONLY by the evidence-bound one-shot enforcer bound to a verified inbound command, and are deliberately absent from that registry so the exception cannot be reused. Mapping existence never creates ordinary consent authority.
qf_mvp_40_decisions.founder_ratified_marketing: client_nurture_followup and dormant_requirement_reactivation are MARKETING on the business lane, per the founder-ratified registry. They require explicit marketing opt-in, are blocked by any suppression and by a generic STOP, and have no transactional fallback.
qf_mvp_40_decisions.provider_template_naming: Deterministic grammar qf_<internal_template_key>_v1: lowercase ASCII, letters/digits/underscore only, unique, version-suffixed, and carrying no environment name, WABA id, secret or client/vendor data. Recorded as provider_template_name_candidate; provider_template_name and provider_template_id stay null until Meta assigns them.
qf_mvp_40_decisions.language_decision: Internal language stays 'en'. Meta's current documentation shows both 'en' and 'en_US' in official examples, so 'en' is NOT proved invalid and no silent en->en_US conversion is introduced. If a specific template is later rejected for its language, that is a per-template provider_language decision recorded here explicitly, never a hidden translation.
